content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To order a starbucks secret menu drink, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Look up the specific base drink for the recipe (2 minutes)
Step 2. Identify the necessary syrup substitutions (1 minute)
Step 3. Note the number of pumps for each syrup (30 seconds)
Step 4. Decide on the size of the drink (15 seconds)
Step 5. Check if the store has the seasonal ingredients (2 minutes)
Step 6. Look for a backup secret recipe in case ingredients are out (5 minutes)
Step 7. Write down the full recipe instructions on your phone (3 minutes)
Step 8. Double-check the total calorie count (1 minute)
Step 9. Calculate the estimated price of the custom drink (2 minutes)
Step 10. Check the caffeine content (1 minute)
Step 11. Read blog posts about the best secret menu combinations (15 minutes)
Step 12. Compare prices between different local Starbucks branches (10 minutes)
Step 13. Place the final order at the counter (2 minutes)
Step 14. Find a reliable secret menu website (1 minute)
Step 15. Memorize the custom name of the drink (5 minutes)
Step 16. Determine if the drink should be iced or hot (10 seconds)
Step 17. Choose the type of milk to use (30 seconds)
Step 18. Prepare to explain the recipe to the barista (2 minutes)
Step 19. Confirm the specific toppings required (1 minute)
Step 20. Open the Starbucks mobile app (30 seconds)
Step 21. Search for current rewards or discounts (4 minutes)
Step 22. Check the balance on your Starbucks card (1 minute)
Step 23. Browse through TikTok for trending drink ideas (20 minutes)
Step 24. Take a screenshot of the drink's visual appearance (10 seconds)
Step 25. Ensure your phone is sufficiently charged (15 minutes)
Step 26. Read reviews of the drink's flavor profile (10 minutes)
Step 27. Locate the nearest Starbucks store (5 minutes)
Step 28. Practice saying the order clearly (3 minutes)
Step 29. Decide if you want a snack to go with it (1 minute)
Step 30. Check the store's operating hours (2 minutes)
Step 31. Put on your shoes and coat (2 minutes)
Step 32. Verify which syrups are standard and which are extra (4 minutes)
Step 33. Check the traffic conditions to the store (3 minutes)
Step 34. Ask a friend for their favorite secret menu item (10 minutes)
Step 35. Consider the sugar content of the drink (2 minutes)
Step 36. Look up the nutritional information (5 minutes)
Step 37. Decide on the amount of ice (15 seconds)
Step 38. Calculate the total stars you will earn (1 minute)
Step 39. Ask a friend if they want a drink too (5 minutes)
Step 40. Reload your Starbucks account balance (3 minutes)
Step 41. Look for a parking spot near the cafe (8 minutes)
Step 42. Check your personal schedule for a free time slot (2 minutes)
Step 43. Clean your reusable cup (5 minutes)
Step 44. Walk from your car to the store entrance (2 minutes)
Step 45. Grab your wallet and keys (1 minute)
Step 46. Wake up and get ready for the day (30 minutes)
Step 47. Check the weather for the walk (1 minute)
Step 48. Select a comfortable seat in the cafe (1 minute)
Step 49. Wait in the queue (10 minutes)
Step 50. Show the recipe to the barista (1 minute)
